name: VCU100 — 観光の日本語 (Japan Travel)
notes: 175 Japanese travel terms and expressions with kana and romaji.
PT-BR companion necessary for paired Portuguese cards.
Locale and terms are for language practice, not instructions for etiquette or fares.
